epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce distinct entity missing-classification errors from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Implement distinct processing and validation for protocol-specific attributes like procedural steps
R2: Implement distinct processing and validation for epidemiological data attributes like sample metrics

slices.title: Patch Java services to validate protocols and raw data
slices.jtbd: When implementing distinct entities for this epic, I want to patch the existing backend code, so that protocols and data are processed with their specific structural attributes.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing generic entity endpoint, When a user submits a protocol, Then the system validates and stores it as a protocol.
Given a user submits epidemiological data, When the payload contains sample metrics, Then the system validates and stores it as data.
Given these changes, When tests run, Then all distinct entity structures are verified to persist successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce distinct entity validation errors from 100% to 0%

epics.title: Material Revision History and Versioning
epics.jtbd: When an epidemiological protocol or material is updated, I want the system to track previous versions, so that I can audit changes and ensure clinical compliance.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of tracked material changes from 0% to 100%
requirements: R1: Track previous versions of protocols and materials upon update
R2: Provide retrieval of historical revisions with author and timestamp

slices.title: Implement version tracking in existing update endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing version history for this epic, I want to patch the existing backend save flow, so that older revisions are archived and queryable.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing protocol is edited, When the save operation completes, Then the previous state is archived as a revision.
Given a client requests the history, When they query the detailed page, Then a list of historical revisions is returned.
Given these changes, When tests run, Then history tracking and retrieval are verified successfully.

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase local deployment success rate to 100%
requirements: R1: Fix launch or health check failure to ensure healthy runtime observation

slices.title: Patch runtime configuration to resolve launch failures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the runtime fix for this epic, I want to patch the broken deployment or boot sequence, so that the stack launches and passes health checks.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a broken local environment, When the start command is executed, Then the stack successfully boots up.
Given a running stack, When the health endpoint is probed, Then it returns a healthy status.
Given these fixes, When tests run, Then system launch stability is verified successfully.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase successful local runtime launches from 0% to 100%
